query: Please provide documentation and examples for implementing a custom AscendC batched matrix multiplication (MatMul) kernel, including TilingData design, TPipe/TQue usage, project.json operator schema, host tiling and InferShape/DataType, aclnn registration, and PyTorch NPU binding.

Ascend C Matmul high-level API for batched matrix multiplication in ND (NORMAL) layout, including matmul::Matmul usage, IterateNBatch, SetBatchInfoForNormal, and host-side tiling/operator registration examples
